tools.name: seo_check
tools.description: On-page SEO check of one public URL: title, meta description, H1, canonical, Open Graph, lang, viewport, noindex, word count and empty JavaScript app shells, robots.txt, XML sitemap, HTTPS, server response time and HTML size. Returns a 0-100 score and a plain-English fix for each issue.

tools.name: ai_visibility_check

tools.name: security_headers_check
tools.description: Passive security check of one public URL: one ordinary page load plus public DNS. tools.name: bulk_check
